results.title: Suspect: The Road Rage Killer
results.overview: Examines the case of Tracie Andrews, who claimed her fiancé had been killed in a shocking road rage attack. After a disastrous press conference, she found herself accused of murdering him. Detectives revisited timelines, cross-checked statements, and tested forensic evidence and slowly, the woman who entered the station as a witness found herself at the centre of suspicion.

results.title: Christine Sinclair: Kind of a Big Deal
results.original_title: Christine Sinclair: Kind of a Big Deal
results.overview: Christine Sinclair scored more international goals than any player in soccer history, men’s or women’s. Moving between the roar of the world stage and the quiet moments behind it, the film reveals a leader whose power lived in restraint, yet she carried Team Canada from underdogs to Olympic gold. A story of how quiet leadership can leave the loudest legacy.

results.title: The Magician's Elephant
results.overview: In the war-scarred town of Baltese, a lonely orphan's search for hope is transformed when a magician conjures an elephant from the sky, setting off a chain of impossible events that changes the lives of everyone around him.

results.title: Finger Guns
results.overview: A privileged office worker rebels when his freedom to use the "finger gun" gesture is threatened in this comedic satire.

results.title: The State of Us
results.overview: Tearaway Frankie breaks out his best friend Taylor for one final night out. Over a riotous few hours filled with laughter, heartbreak and some home truths, the boys will face the ultimate test.

results.title: 15 Aala Kamra
results.overview: The room features an old cupboard tied with a sacred red thread. Pandit convinces the group that supernatural spirits live inside and warns them never to open it, turning the cupboard into a constant source of fear and humor throughout their stay.

results.title: Shine!
results.overview: Davide has a dream: to become a professional wrestler. For him, it’s a full-blown obsession - nothing can stop him. Except for a few details: he doesn’t have Hulk Hogan’s muscles, he’s still in high school, and most of all... he’s terrified of jumping out of the ring.

results.title: The Cat Kingdom
results.overview: The unemployed engineer Kenneth devotes all his time building hobby models. On his way to an imposed job interview, Kenneth runs in to the marine scientist Sten, who offers him an assistant job down at his shipyard. Kenneth’s heavily pregnant partner Marta draws a sigh of relief, but what begins with a simple painting job gradually develops into suspicious investigation work.

results.title: The Witnesses
results.overview: Alban and Inès married in Albania, in the presence of their best friends and witnesses Pierre and Lola. But six months later, when they return from their honeymoon, Alban and Inès discover that in fact it is not them but... their witnesses who are married, following an administrative error!

results.title: Ice Twister
results.overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

results.title: Pocket Mirror
results.overview: A lonely retail clerk who spends most of her time chatting with AI struggles to identify the source of her unshakeable unease.

results.title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
results.overview: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

results.title: Missed
results.overview: June, a 35-year-old woman reeling from a missed miscarriage, returns to her car to find an uninvited passenger: a loud, cheerful puppet named Daisy. What begins as a waking nightmare becomes something unexpected. Daisy shifts from nuisance to companion, helping June navigate grief, logistics, and the impossible pressure to just "get over it." A dark comedy about loss, motherhood, and the strange forms comfort can take.

results.title: The Shape of Invisible Skies
results.overview: An anthology of seven stories exploring the unseen spaces that shape us: between memory and desire, departure and return. Each lifetime captures fleeting moments of connection and transformation across time and space, where meaning hides behind invisible skies

results.title: Little Bottom
results.overview: Nathan, a rather slender 19-year-old young man, and Rodrigo, a man in his thirties, meet in a club and decide to spend the night together. Nathan’s physique and youth spark a desire for change in Rodrigo, who is usually “passive” and decides that, on this particular night, he will be “active.” What could have been a simple one-night stand turns into an awkward struggle, as each partner tries to remain in the role that his body seems to assign him.

results.title: Joy of Joys
results.overview: This documentary goes behind the scenes at Abbey Road Studios to capture the recording of the Mercury Prize–nominated HELP(2), a 2026 charity album from War Child Records, which aids children in conflict zones around the world. To make the film, Glazer enlisted some crucial help: young schoolkids from London were equipped with their own digital cameras and encouraged to shoot the studio recordings any way they wanted. Their curiosity and creativity are paralleled in footage taken by high-spirited children in war-torn parts of the globe—Gaza, Sudan, Ukraine, Yemen—whom Glazer also supplied with cameras. The resulting film, which Glazer and regular music collaborator Mica Levi have dubbed “by children, for children,” serves as a testament to youthful openness and wonder amidst the evils of the adult world.

results.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
results.overview: In this new pseudo-vintage silent short film, a scientist discovers the horrible consequences when he allows his dark side complete control. This is directed by Gary Hill, and the novella "Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde" by Robert Louis Stevenson.

results.title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
results.overview: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common — in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case.
